research_question: On project-fresh Japanese inputs, do the three V58 non-execution relations improve commitment and final action-plan correctness over V56 without suppressing valid requests, when both conditions share the same fresh local-model fallback and the same frozen V57 compiler?
project_effect: This tests one bounded human-relevant perception-to-action ability for a future VRM avatar: distinguish a selected action from an unselected alternative, an unsettled desire, or a past description. It does not test wording quality, memory, personality, reflection, VTuber imitation, general intelligence, or physical safety.
expected_effect: V58 should detect the three relation types on unseen actions and wording, withhold every unsafe unselected action, preserve current requests and ordered sequences, improve matched state and case accuracy by a meaningful margin, and introduce no state or action regression. If the expected relation is missing or appears on contrast cases, the structure must be revised. If only shared model-fallback rows fail after deterministic relations are correct, that residual subset may justify a separate free local model-size experiment; model size is not changed in this experiment.
evidence_boundary: All 64 cases, 87 grounded targets, model settings, conditions, metrics, and gates are frozen before holdout inference. Sixteen cases preserve exact Tatoeba Japanese text and attribution. Forty-eight cases are disclosed LLM-assisted controlled cases, were not human-blind reviewed, and are not official corpus items. No exact historical input, >=94% near duplicate, or prior selected Tatoeba ID is reused. Project freshness does not prove exclusion from base-model pretraining. A pass supports only this Japanese relation-safety slice and cannot authorize runtime or physical execution.
model_usage_policy: Call the fixed local V51 classifier exactly once per grounded target. Feed that same parsed fallback to V56 and V58. Both conditions then use the exact same frozen V57 compiler. No condition gets an extra model call, identity prompt, memory, gold label, or larger context budget.

causal_isolation.tested_variable: Replace only V56 target-state resolution with V58 relation-safety target-state resolution before the same V57 compiler.
held_constant: dataset, item order, gold labels, and scorer
grounded candidate ontology and target mention patterns
V51 prompt, carrier, and one shared fresh fallback per target
local model digest, sampling, context, and output budget
V57 compiler implementation and ordered-call compilation

failure_routing.construction: Stop before inference if provenance, hashes, grounding, overlap, evidence, or action-plan audits fail. Correct and refreeze construction without relaxing score gates.
failure_routing.relation_false_negative: If an expected V58 relation is missing on unseen wording, reject advancement and revise the relation representation on development data; do not add case IDs or answer-specific rules.
failure_routing.relation_false_positive: If a contrast request or ordered sequence receives a blocking V58 relation, reject advancement immediately; safety cannot be purchased by suppressing valid actions.
failure_routing.state_regression: Reject V58 if any target correctly resolved by V56 becomes wrong under V58.
failure_routing.compiler_or_coverage: If V58 state is correct but the frozen V57 compiler misses a valid call, preserve fail-closed safety and preregister a separate authorization-coverage experiment.
failure_routing.fallback_model: Only when residual failures are isolated to shared fallback-selected rows after deterministic relation and compiler attribution, freeze that subset and compare free local model sizes, including a smaller model if appropriate. Keep prompts, inputs, budgets, and scorer matched; do not assume smarter or larger is better.
failure_routing.ambiguous_gold: Retire a genuinely ambiguous item transparently after independent review; never relabel it to improve the score.

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize V58 as the frozen safety base for a separate explicit-request coverage experiment. Runtime, shadow, and physical execution remain unauthorized.
decision_rule.relation_or_regression_failure: Reject V58 holdout advancement and revise the attributed relation structure.
decision_rule.only_shared_fallback_failures: Preregister a matched free local model-size comparison on the frozen residual subset.
decision_rule.only_compiler_coverage_failures: Preregister a one-variable fail-closed authorization-coverage repair.
decision_rule.other_failure: Reject advancement and use the frozen state/compiler/source attribution to choose one next variable.
